answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 3790 Country: United States of America Title: My question is if your not married anymore do I need a wahlkil to get married and if I do how would I go about it? Question: My question is if your not married anymore do I need a wahlkil to get married and if I do how would I go about it? Answer ID: 3790 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 47/47=M) If the boy and girl who are to marry are present in the meeting of nikah then there is no need of appointing a wakeel . Yes, in case any of the two is not present in the meeting of nikah due to any reason then he or she has to appoint a wakeel who will either put offer of nikah or will accept it; since the offer of nikah and its acceptance is to be made in single meeting. A wakeel of nikah should be one who is trusted. While appointing him wakeel you should say: "Get me married to that person." If he accepts this offer he will be your wakeel . Generally, the qazi becomes wakeel from girl who acts with permission of the girl or her wali (guardian). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
